nativePolicy: Keep exact source depth, affine transform, caret, pointer trajectory, diagram outlines and button gradients. Replace only source glyph contours with modern SVG text, centered on source text bounds; set native text to 500 units and use width=17.6 × max(1rem,18px), giving exactly18px normal/32px enlarged whole math units after inverse source text-scale compensation in the renderer. Prose is separate native HTML using exact whole-word mask thresholds. This changes typography and does not claim pixel fidelity.
